meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自己操控浏览器：打开网页、读取页面按钮和输入框、点击、填表、滚动、截图、导出 PDF、提取文字和链接，还能保存登录状态供下次使用。
howto.when: 当任务需要浏览网页、查资料、操作网页应用时自动触发；即使用户没明确说，只要浏览器有用也会使用。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截全页图保存
在必应搜索 Agent，把前三个结果的标题和链接列出来
say.note: 会打开搜索页、读取元素并提取文字和链接。

say.text: 打开登录页，帮我填用户名密码并点登录
say.note: 会使用 fill 和 click 操作表单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can drive a browser itself: open URLs, read page elements like buttons and inputs, click, fill forms, scroll, take screenshots, export PDFs, extract text and links, and save/load login state.
howto.when_en: Activated whenever a task involves browsing the web, researching, or interacting with web apps; triggers even if the user does not explicitly ask, as long as a browser would help.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Runs open and screenshot --full, saves to temp dir.

say_en.text: Search Bing for Agent and list the top 3 results with links.
say_en.note: Opens the search page, reads elements, extracts text and links.

say_en.text: Open the login page, fill in username and password, then click Login.
say_en.note: Uses fill and click to operate the form.
